# Somae Design

> Working design system v0.2.0 for Somae: a compact interface for sending messages to agents and receiving signals. Wave is the selected mark. All materials use neutral near-black surfaces. Accent is reserved for brand and a primary action; focus, selection and annotations have separate neutral roles. Electric is the default material; Infrared and After hours are experimental.

## Start here

- [Visual guide](./index.html): Interactive reference for colors, typography, components, and motion.
- [Agent guide](./agent-guide.md): Design intent, implementation rules, accessibility, and product boundaries.

## Tokens

- [Canonical tokens](./tokens.json): DTCG 2025.10 source values with descriptions and status.
- [CSS variables](./tokens.css): Generated semantic variables and theme selectors.
- [JavaScript exports](./tokens.js): CSS-ready values, themes, metadata, and cssVariables(theme).
- [TypeScript declarations](./tokens.d.ts): Types for the JavaScript exports.
- [Token catalog](./catalog.json): Flat generated token index for lookup and tooling.

## Brand

- [Wave](./assets/wave.svg): Approved single-color SVG using currentColor.
- [Wave in ink](./assets/wave-ink.svg): Explicit ink fill for image embedding.
- [Wave in acid](./assets/wave-acid.svg): Explicit acid fill for image embedding.
